title: Quick Creamy Greek Squash Tzatziki
description: A quick and delicious vegetarian Greek dish featuring roasted sweet squash, creamy yogurt, and a tangy kombu-cold-extract, all combined with the freshness of cucumber and mint.
instructions: Toss the butternut squash with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Soak the kombu sheets in water for 30 minutes, then blend with 1 cup of water to make a kombu-cold-extract.
Peel and chop the cucumber, and combine it with the roasted squash, garlic, lemon juice, and mint leaves in a bowl.
Stir in the Greek yogurt, kombu-cold-extract, salt, and black pepper. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and garnish with additional mint leaves, if desired.
